UI_SQViewpointSimulation_ModeTooltip: Sets the simulation update rate for Viewpoint's 3D view in single-player. Off follows the regular game loop and configured display framerate limit.
UI_SQViewpointSimulation_Ready: Applies when you select Apply. Defaults to 60 Hz.
UI_SQViewpointSimulation_Unavailable: Simulation rate is unavailable. Check Viewpoint support, ZombieBuddy and Java approval, then restart.
